clue.text: No attacking group of soccer players could be couth?

definitions.text: No attacking group of soccer players
definitions.meaning: a defensive line-up, the backs of a football team as against its attackers
a word made by stripping a supposed affix off an older word, as couth was formed from uncouth

explanation.walkthrough: Couth is the classic example: the negative 'uncouth' came first, and 'couth' was later made from it by dropping the prefix.
explanation.definitionFit: Linguists name a word coined by removing an apparent affix from an existing word with this term, and couth is a textbook case.

clue.text: Idea works for the most part

indicators.note: taking most but not all of a word, so the final letter of the synonym is dropped

parts.note: a plant is a factory or works

explanation.surface: An idea mostly does the job.
explanation.definitionFit: A plan is a scheme or proposal, so an idea for doing something.

clue.text: To north, soldiers occupying slope, making camp

indicators.note: the words before it sit inside the slope word, as troops occupy ground

parts.note: cant is a slope or tilt
taken as written
men are soldiers, as in officers and men

explanation.surface: Troops heading north take up position on a hillside to set up camp.
explanation.definitionFit: A cantonment is a military camp or station, especially historically in India; 'making' is a link.

clue.text: Calypso composed without admission, ultimately, of loss of sound

indicators.note: here meaning outside: the rearranged letters go around the final letter
the letters of the Caribbean song word are arranged anew, as music is composed
points to the last letter of the word admission

explanation.surface: A calypso is written with no admission, giving a description of losing sound.
explanation.walkthrough: 'composed' turns CALYPSO into SYCOPAL; 'without' (outside) puts it round N, the last letter of 'admission' picked by 'ultimately'.
explanation.definitionFit: Syncope is the dropping of sounds from the middle of a word, so syncopal is the adjective describing such a loss.

clue.text: Retrospective look by someone beautiful getting on a bit

indicators.note: looking backwards, so the short word for look is read in reverse

parts.note: lo is an old word for look or behold
a dish is slang for an attractive person

explanation.surface: Glancing back at an attractive person who is no longer young.
explanation.definitionFit: Oldish means somewhat old, which is getting on a bit in years.

clue.text: Expert entertaining charmingly old-fashioned duke at home?

indicators.note: an entertainer holds guests, so the expert word takes the next piece inside it

parts.note: an ace is an expert
quaint means attractively old-fashioned

explanation.surface: A skilled person hosts a quaint old duke in their house.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that 'at home' is not about a house: to be at home with something is to be familiar with it.
explanation.definitionFit: Being at home with a subject means being familiar or acquainted with it.

clue.text: Knowing what can give building a sense of height

definitions.meaning: knowing in the sense of sly, roguish or playfully mischievous

definitions.text: what can give building a sense of height
definitions.meaning: a curved structure spanning an opening, which raises a building's look upward

explanation.definitionFit: Arch as an adjective means slyly knowing, and as a noun it is a curved span in architecture.

clue.text: Tie can be a nuisance

explanation.definitionFit: Bind means to fasten with a cord, and informally a bind is an annoying situation.

clue.text: Characters in retreat organised, having got together in a sort of line

indicators.note: the rearranged letters have the next piece held within them
the letters of retreat are put in a new order

parts.note: met means got together

explanation.surface: Letters in a retreat, once organised and having met up, form some kind of line.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organised' rearranges the seven letters into TETRAER, which 'having' wraps round the meeting word; 'Characters in' only says to use the word's letters, and the line is one of verse, not a queue.
explanation.definitionFit: A tetrameter is a line of verse with four metrical feet, a type of poetic line.

clue.text: Ottoman bigwigs collecting gold in marketplaces

indicators.note: the officials gather up the next piece, taking it inside

parts.note: aga was a title of Ottoman commanders and officials
or is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: Turkish dignitaries gather gold in the markets.
explanation.definitionFit: An agora was a public square and market in ancient Greek cities.

clue.text: Don conceals passion for flighty type

indicators.note: the clothing word hides the next piece inside itself

parts.note: to don clothes is to wear them
heat means passion or intensity of feeling

explanation.surface: A university don hides his passion for a frivolous person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Don' looks like a university teacher but is the verb meaning to put on; 'flighty type' is a bird, not a fickle person.
explanation.definitionFit: The wheatear is a small songbird, so jokingly a type that takes flight.

clue.text: River animal trapped in torrent? Plank of wood produced

indicators.note: the river and animal pieces are caught inside the torrent word

parts.note: a flood is a torrent of water
a boar is a wild pig

explanation.surface: A river creature is caught in a torrent and a plank of wood turns up.
explanation.definitionFit: A floorboard is one of the long wooden planks forming a floor; 'produced' is a link.

clue.text: Mate's quiet manner

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quiet
an air is a manner or bearing

explanation.surface: A friend's gentle bearing.
explanation.definitionFit: To mate animals is to pair them, and a pair is two matched partners.

clue.text: Alert's checked out — prepare for action

indicators.note: the letters are thrown out of order and rearranged

explanation.surface: An alarm has been investigated, so get ready to act.
explanation.definitionFit: Clearing the decks is an idiom from warships, removing clutter so as to be ready to fight.

clue.text: Warning precedes sport at sea — no time for complaining

parts.note: a bell sounds a warning

indicators.note: the letter for time is removed from the sailing word

parts.note: yachting is sailing as a sport

explanation.surface: An alarm sounds before a sailing race, with no time for moaning.
explanation.walkthrough: T is the standard abbreviation for time.
explanation.definitionFit: Bellyaching is informal for grumbling or complaining.

clue.text: Like solid form of image putting one off

indicators.note: with off, this asks for a piece to be taken away from the word
together with putting, it signals removal of the letter for one

parts.note: iconic means relating to an image or icon
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A shape resembling a solid picture loses its appeal.
explanation.definitionFit: Conic means cone-shaped, describing the solid figure a cone.

clue.text: Cosmetic ingredient to limit soreness

indicators.note: the component word is placed around the next piece, enclosing it

parts.note: a facet is one element or aspect of something
pain is soreness

explanation.surface: A cosmetic component that limits irritation of the skin.
explanation.definitionFit: Face paint is a type of make-up applied to the face, so a cosmetic.

clue.text: Lock telephone up after call

indicators.note: the telephone piece comes after the call piece

parts.note: to ring is to call on the phone

indicators.note: in a down entry, up means the word is written upward, in reverse

explanation.surface: Lock the phone away after making a call.
explanation.definitionFit: A ringlet is a curled lock of hair.

clue.text: Very eager, having nothing, to get as much as one likes

definitions.text: to get as much as one likes

parts.note: agog means eager or keenly expectant
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Someone very keen and with nothing wants to have their fill.
explanation.definitionFit: A gogo is an idiom meaning in abundance or without limit, as in drinks a gogo.

clue.text: Present time wrong for restricting those bringing us news

indicators.note: the scrambled letters hold the news providers inside them
the letters of time are put the wrong way round, scrambled

parts.note: the media bring us the news

explanation.surface: Now is the wrong moment to restrict journalists.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrong' scrambles the four letters to IMTE, which 'restricting' splits around the news word; 'Present' is the adjective meaning current, not a gift.
explanation.definitionFit: Immediate means happening now, in the present.

clue.text: Maybe a word identifying person that's loveless and religious

indicators.note: love is zero in tennis, written as O, so that letter is removed

parts.note: a noun is a word naming a person, place or thing; maybe flags that a person is just one example

explanation.surface: Perhaps the word for someone without love and devoted to faith.
explanation.definitionFit: A nun is a member of a female religious order, a religious in the noun sense.

clue.text: Hidden stars who may work in offices?

parts.note: secret means hidden
Aries is a constellation, a group of stars

explanation.surface: Concealed celebrities who might have office jobs.
explanation.definitionFit: Secretaries are administrative staff who typically work in offices.

clue.text: Working for head of government, I suffered

parts.note: to work under someone is to work for them

indicators.note: points to the first letter of government

parts.note: I as a pronoun can be one, as in one feels

explanation.surface: Working for the leader of the government, I suffered.
explanation.definitionFit: To have undergone something is to have suffered or experienced it.

clue.text: Performance outside a haunt had finally stopped (in Las Vegas?)

indicators.note: the performance word sits around the following pieces

parts.note: a deed is an act or performance
a den is a haunt or hideout

indicators.note: picks the last letter of had

explanation.surface: An act outside a hangout had at last come to a halt in a Nevada city.
explanation.walkthrough: The bracketed Las Vegas flags an Americanism: a dead-ended road or career has come to a stop.
explanation.definitionFit: Dead-ended, chiefly American usage, describes something that has come to a halt with no way forward.

clue.text: What to get fussed about — parking in that track not for cars

indicators.note: the parking letter goes inside the jumbled letters
fussing about stirs things up, so these letters are jumbled

parts.note: P is the symbol for parking

explanation.surface: Something to get worked up about: parking on a path closed to vehicles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'get fussed about' turns WHAT TO into TOWATH; 'in' puts P inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A towpath runs beside a canal or river for horses towing barges, a track closed to motor traffic.

clue.text: Weep with hesitation, being dignified?

parts.note: to sob is to weep
er is a sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: Crying with a pause, yet staying composed.
explanation.definitionFit: Sober can mean serious and staid in manner, close to dignified.

clue.text: Chief in charge of subject

parts.note: top means chief or leading

explanation.surface: The head in charge of the matter.
explanation.definitionFit: A topic is a subject of discussion.

clue.text: 100,000 in rupees? Not enough from what we hear

indicators.note: signals that a word is to be said out loud and spelt differently

parts.note: lack means a shortage, not enough

explanation.surface: A hundred thousand rupees is still too little, by all accounts.
explanation.definitionFit: In South Asia a lac or lakh is the unit for one hundred thousand, usually of rupees.
